## \#\# Built    with    Conviction

**One of One. From Day One. All In.**

These are the core principles that allow us to bring our undivided focus and true partnership ethos to every founder. When we go, we go all in.

[Read our philosophy](https://www.elevationcapital.com/philosophy)

![Urban Company Founders](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/gxmub2ol/redesign-2024/7313200fb2e35d7b525ce99bcca348514ef9b381-1200x899.png/Urban%20Company.png?rect=1,0,1199,899&w=320&h=240&auto=format)

Urban Company

We invested in Urban Company during their MVP days and doubled down as they became full-stack, going against conventional wisdom.

![Firstcry Founder](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/gxmub2ol/redesign-2024/12895205b6e46c4c3e34ab2357f0027642be8f22-3228x3426.jpg/Firstcry_Supam.jpg?rect=0,82,2802,2993&fp-x=0.4340424233294548&fp-y=0.4609170442134777&w=320&h=342&fit=crop&crop=focalpoint&auto=format)

FirstCry

We backed FirstCry’s omnichannel approach when it was not in vogue, and the need for a vertical player in the category was questioned.

![Meesho Founders](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/gxmub2ol/redesign-2024/badcc63ce637be826d9abf196b1af79a26dd156e-2400x1602.jpg/time100-companies-Meesho-2023.jpg?rect=2,0,2396,1602&w=320&h=214&auto=format)

Meesho

We invested in Meesho when e-commerce in India looked overcrowded, partnered through their pivot to a horizontal platform as they became India’s largest true e-commerce marketplace.
